This page is the interactive version of the lesson notes (PDF). Each section
is one step of the seminar. It ends with a **Do it** task and one set of
questions. The full explanations, examples and exercises are in the notes.

## Key terms

{{< glossary android-studio avd system-image emulator adb apk logcat game-build >}}

## 26.1 Create and start the virtual device

- Device Manager → Create device → profile + **system image** → name.
- Start: the first **cold boot** is slow; then **quick boot**.
- Terminal: `emulator -list-avds`, `emulator -avd P5_API_30`.

![The steps of the seminar.](images/seminar-steps.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
No start? Check virtualization in the BIOS and free RAM.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Steps 1–3"}
Create and start `P5_API_30`; write how long the first boot took.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Steps 1–3"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="the Play Store|a USB cable"}
where you create an AVD
:   the Device Manager

the slow first start
:   a cold boot

the command that lists the AVDs
:   emulator -list-avds

a common reason the emulator does not start
:   virtualization is off
:::
:::

## 26.2 Install the build

- **Drag and drop** the APK, or **adb install**.
- `adb devices` must show `emulator-5554 device`.

![Commands of the seminar.](images/adb-commands.png){width=94%}

{{< sim file="sims/adb-lab.html" poster="sims/adb-lab.png" title="Emulator Lab: run Pocket Quest 1.3" height="720" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
"No such file": run adb in the APK's folder or give the full path.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Step 4"}
Install the build by drag and drop and with `adb install`; copy the output
of `adb devices`.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Installing"}
Use Emulator Lab. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Restart the router|Buy a phone"}
adb: no devices/emulators found
:   start the emulator first

the output after a good install
:   Success

the command that lists connected devices
:   adb devices

the command that shows the log
:   adb logcat
:::
:::

## 26.3 Run the test cases and collect evidence

- Follow the plan in order; pass or fail.
- **Extended controls:** rotation, battery, location, network, calls.
- Evidence: a **screenshot** and the **Logcat** lines; repeat once.

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Copy the lines around the error, not the whole log.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Steps 5–6"}
In **Emulator Lab**, run test case 7, read the log, take a screenshot; on
the lab emulator, try a slow network.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Test case 7"}
Use Emulator Lab. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="the battery|the font"}
what freezes the race
:   turning to landscape

the file named in the error
:   RaceHud.cs

the line number of the error
:   118

why you repeat a failed case
:   to be sure it happens again
:::
:::

## 26.4 Write the bug report

- **Title**, **build**, **device and OS**, **steps**, **expected**,
  **actual**, **attachments**.
- One bug per report; facts, not opinions.

![A good bug report.](images/bug-report.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Report what you did and saw; the developer finds the cause.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Your test report"}
A one-page test report: environment, eight cases with pass or fail, one
complete bug report.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Bug reports"}
Choose the part of the report.

::: {.match extra="the price|the weather"}
PocketQuest_1.3 (build 42)
:   the build

AVD P5_API_30, Android 11
:   the device

"the race goes on in landscape"
:   expected

"the screen freezes"
:   actual
:::
:::

## Game challenge: Report Doctor {.challenge}

Work alone. Use every section of today.

Six reports: **no device**, **no steps**, only **"looks bad"**, **no build
number**, **three bugs** at once, **no log or screenshot**.

{{< sim file="sims/report-doctor.html" poster="sims/report-doctor.png" title="Report Doctor: fix the bug reports" kind="game" height="520" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The reports"}
Choose what must be fixed.

::: {.match extra="a longer title|a nicer font"}
"Race freezes" without a device
:   add the device and OS version

"Crash" without steps
:   add numbered steps

"looks bad"
:   write expected and actual

freeze, wrong coins and a small font
:   one bug per report
:::
:::

## Summary {.summary}

- Create an AVD in the Device Manager and start it.
- Install the APK by drag and drop or with adb install.
- Run the test cases; use the extended controls.
- Collect a screenshot and the Logcat lines; repeat once.
- Write one bug per report with build, device, steps, expected, actual.
